description: This file defines the ProviderService interface for managing Provider entities in the OpenMRS system. It includes method signatures for creating, retrieving, updating, retiring, unretiring, and deleting providers and related entities such as provider attributes and roles. The interface also contains methods for querying providers based on various criteria, ensuring consistency and encapsulating business logic related to providers.

classes.name: ProviderService
classes.description: Interface for provider-related operations, including CRUD, querying, attribute and role management, and retire/unretire functionalities.

methods.name: getAllProviders
methods.description: Retrieves all providers, including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllProviders
methods.description: Retrieves all providers, optionally including retired providers based on the parameter.

methods.name: retireProvider
methods.description: Marks a provider as retired with a specified reason.

methods.name: unretireProvider
methods.description: Reactivates a previously retired provider.

methods.name: purgeProvider
methods.description: Deletes a provider from the system.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a provider by its ID.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves or updates a provider in the database.

methods.name: getProviderByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a provider by its UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson
methods.description: Gets providers associated with a specific person.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson
methods.description: Gets providers associated with a specific person, including or excluding retired.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Searches for providers matching a query string with additional filters.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Searches for providers matching a query string, including retired providers.

methods.name: getCountOfProviders
methods.description: Counts providers matching a query excluding retired.

methods.name: getCountOfProviders
methods.description: Counts providers matching a query with optional inclusion of retired providers.

methods.name: getAllProviderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all provider attribute types, including retired.

methods.name: getAllProviderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all provider attribute types with option to include retired.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a provider attribute type by ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a provider attribute type by UUID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a provider attribute type by name, requires authorization.

methods.name: getProviderAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a provider attribute by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a provider attribute by its UUID.

methods.name: saveProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a provider attribute type.

methods.name: retireProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a provider attribute type with a reason.

methods.name: unretireProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires a provider attribute type.

methods.name: purgeProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a provider attribute type.

methods.name: isProviderIdentifierUnique
methods.description: Checks if a provider's identifier is unique.

methods.name: getProviderByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a provider by case-insensitive identifier.

methods.name: getUnknownProvider
methods.description: Gets the special 'unknown provider' account.

methods.name: getProviderRole
methods.description: Retrieves a provider role by ID.

methods.name: getAllProviderRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all provider roles, optionally including retired.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a provider role by UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles
methods.description: Gets providers assigned to specific roles.

methods.name: saveProviderRole
methods.description: Saves or updates a provider role.

methods.name: retireProviderRole
methods.description: Retires a provider role with a reason.

methods.name: unretireProviderRole
methods.description: Unretires a provider role.

methods.name: purgeProviderRole
methods.description: Deletes a provider role.
